fusions.name: Shake It Dead
fusions.desc: Seizes an enemy up to 3 tiles away and shakes it for 22 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Rally the Kennel
fusions.desc: Rats and hounds surge out together in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Terrier Off the Leash
fusions.desc: Looses a terrier that hunts alongside your rats for 18 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Closes Ranks
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, the pack closes around you as a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
